llm.summary: This is a classroom coaching skill that provides teaching prompts and templates, with disclosed limited classroom-observation write-back behavior.

dimensions.detail: The skill uses lesson goals, student-layering context, and classroom observation signals, which are proportionate for education coaching, but users should avoid entering unnecessary student identifiers.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is Markdown content plus Markdown reference templates; no executable scripts, package installation, shell commands, or hidden install behavior were present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The trigger phrases include some broad classroom terms such as generic grouping or classroom-silence requests, but the runtime instructions stay within teacher-facing classroom interaction design.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill discloses write-back to student-analyzer or lesson-log using aggregate interaction data and explicitly says not to write back student names, though reference templates include placeholders that could be filled with names if users are careless.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill's capabilities fit its stated purpose: designing classroom questions, group activities, cold-call/cold-room responses, feedback methods, and post-class observation templates for teachers.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, confirm you want this skill to activate for classroom interaction and group-work planning. Use aggregate classroom observations when possible, and avoid entering student names or sensitive student details into post-class records unless your local policy allows it.
llm.findings: [SQP-1] expected: The broad trigger phrases could cause occasional misrouting, but they are classroom-oriented and the skill only provides teaching guidance/templates, so this does not create a material Review concern by itself.
